rules.top_level: BUY / FAIR / REACH / FADE; PRICE PENDING is never force-classified
rules.sleepers: SLEEPER and CONDITIONAL BUY roll into BUY as subtypes
rules.deep_stash: DEEP STASH rolls into FAIR because it is not an active draft target at normal roster depth
rules.value_watch: VALUE WATCH promotes to BUY only with multi-edge confirmation, >=12 spots of price edge, and opportunity score >=6.5
rules.fade: REACH escalates to FADE only when market premium and downside risk are both severe
rules.authority: market layer cannot independently mutate True Value, Overall rank, projections, or player-quality scores
